title: list-threat-shield output
description: Nethesis Threat Shield feed catalog, enablement state, decision counts and last import status

subscription.title: subscription
subscription.description: True if the cluster has a subscription identity

entitled.title: entitled
entitled.description: True if the subscription carries the blocklist entitlement

type.title: type
type.description: Resolved subscription type used in the feed URLs (enterprise or community), empty if unknown

key.title: key
key.description: Catalog key of the feed, "nethesis-insights" for the virtual fleet-consensus feed, or custom-<name> for a custom blocklist

description.title: description
description.description: Human readable feed name; for a custom blocklist its description as entered, possibly empty

enabled.title: enabled
enabled.description: True if the feed is currently imported

count.title: count
count.description: Active decisions currently held by this feed

blocked_24h.title: blocked_24h
blocked_24h.description: Packets from this feed's addresses blocked by the firewall in the last 24 hours; an address on several feeds is credited to the highest-confidence one

confidence.title: confidence
confidence.description: How much to trust this feed, 1-10; -1 means not rated (e.g. a community subscription or a custom blocklist)

url.title: url
url.description: URL of a custom blocklist, empty for catalog feeds

allowlists.title: allowlists
allowlists.description: The built-in Nethesis allowlist (only with a subscription), then the custom allowlists

name.description: "nethesis" for the built-in row, else the custom allowlist name

url.description: URL of a custom allowlist, empty for the built-in row

enabled.description: True if the allowlist is imported

builtin.description: True for the Nethesis global allowlist, which cannot be edited or deleted

last_import.title: last_import
last_import.description: Outcome of the last import run, absent until the timer has run once

timestamp.title: timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the last import run

error.title: error
error.description: Error that aborted the whole run, null when the run completed

allowlists.title: allowlists
allowlists.description: Per-allowlist outcome, keyed by allowlist name ("nethesis" for the built-in one), same shape as feeds

feeds.title: feeds
feeds.description: Per-feed outcome, keyed by catalog key

success.title: success
success.description: True if the feed was fetched and imported

error.title: error
error.description: Failure reason, or a notice such as a truncated custom list; null otherwise

timestamp.title: timestamp
timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of the last import run, same as last_import.timestamp
